title: Generators
explain: A generator produces values one at a time instead of building the whole list in memory. A function with `yield` becomes a generator, and it pauses at each `yield` until the next value is asked for. This makes huge or endless sequences cheap.
exercise: Write a generator that yields the first n Fibonacci numbers and print them with a loop.
tip: A generator can be used only once. After it is exhausted, looping over it again gives nothing, so call the function again for a fresh one.
